newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Viacom raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Viacom raised to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros said it raised its recommendation on Viacom Inc to buy from hold.

-- "The stock is down 30 percent since we initiated coverage ... with a hold rating (May 22. 1996) and 43 percent from the September 1995 high of 54-1/4 reached prior to the beginning of a long stretch of estimate cuts," according to the analyst's report.
-- "We believe the current price offers an attractive entry point largely because we believe that downward EBITDA estimate revisions are behind Viacom," the report adds.
-- Salomon's 1996 earnings estimate is $0.28 per share on EBITDA of $2.175 billion, which includes $64 million in cash flow from the sold cable television operation.
-- In midday American Stock Exchange trade, Viacom shares were up 2-3/8 to 32-3/4.
